name: Anubis
summary: Anubis is a trend-following Expert Advisor that uses moving average crossovers combined with momentum filters to identify and ride market trends. It enters trades when fast and slow moving averages cross in the direction of the prevailing trend confirmed by a momentum oscillator. The EA includes built-in stop loss and take profit management with optional trailing stop functionality.
summary_zh: Anubis是一个趋势跟踪型智能交易系统，利用均线交叉结合动量过滤器来识别并跟随市场趋势。当快速均线和慢速均线在动量震荡指标确认的趋势方向上交叉时入场交易。该EA内置止损止盈管理，并带有可选的移动止损功能。
strategy_analysis: Anubis EA的核心策略基于双均线交叉系统，通过快速均线与慢速均线的金叉和死叉来判断趋势方向。入场条件要求均线交叉信号必须得到动量指标（如RSI或MACD）的确认，避免在震荡行情中产生虚假信号。出场条件包括固定止损止盈以及可选的移动止损，后者在趋势延续时锁定利润。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额百分比的风险计算方式，确保单笔交易风险可控。资金管理方面，EA提供了最大持仓限制和最大回撤保护参数，防止过度交易和账户资金大幅缩水。整体策略逻辑清晰，但在强震荡市中均线交叉容易频繁发出错误信号，需要配合过滤条件使用。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of the Anubis EA is based on a dual moving average crossover system, using golden cross and death cross of fast and slow moving averages to determine trend direction. Entry conditions require that the MA crossover signal be confirmed by a momentum indicator such as RSI or MACD, avoiding false signals in ranging markets. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels along with an optional trailing stop that locks in profits as the trend extends. Position sizing employs either fixed lot sizes or risk-based calculation using a percentage of account balance, ensuring controlled risk per trade. Money management features include maximum position limits and maximum drawdown protection parameters to prevent overtrading and significant account equity depletion. The overall strategy logic is clear and well-structured, though MA crossovers can generate frequent false signals in strongly ranging markets, necessitating complementary filter conditions.
pros: 双均线交叉配合动量确认，入场信号较为可靠
内置止损止盈和移动止损机制，风险控制完善
提供固定手数和风险百分比两种仓位管理模式，灵活性高
参数设计合理，用户可根据市场状况灵活调整
趋势行情中表现优异，能够较好地捕捉中长期趋势
pros_en: Dual MA crossover with momentum confirmation provides relatively reliable entry signals
Built-in SL/TP and trailing stop mechanisms offer solid risk control
Flexible position sizing with both fixed lot and risk percentage modes
Well-designed parameters allow users to adapt to varying market conditions
Excellent performance in trending markets, effectively capturing medium to long-term trends
cons: 均线交叉属于滞后指标，入场信号存在延迟
震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏多时间框架确认机制，单周期判断可能不够稳健
移动止损参数固定，未根据市场波动率动态调整
未包含点差过滤条件，在高点差环境下可能不利
cons_en: MA crossover is a lagging indicator, resulting in delayed entry signals
Prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, single timeframe analysis may not be robust enough
Trailing stop uses fixed parameters without dynamic adjustment based on market volatility
No spread filter included, which may be disadvantageous in high-spread environments
improvements: 增加多时间框架趋势确认，例如在H4趋势方向上执行H1的交叉信号
引入ATR动态止损和移动止损，根据市场波动率自适应调整止损距离
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe trend confirmation, such as executing H1 crossover signals only in the direction of H4 trend
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop loss and trailing stop that adapts to market volatility

risk_points: 均线交叉在震荡市中可能产生频繁虚假信号导致连续小额亏损
缺乏点差过滤机制，在流动性不足时段可能因滑点和点差造成额外损失
risk_points_en: MA crossovers may generate frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive small losses
Lack of spread filter may cause additional costs from slippage and wide spreads during low-liquidity sessions

It enters trades when fast and slow moving averages cross in the direction of the prevailing trend confirmed by a momentum oscillator. The EA includes built-in stop loss and take profit management with optional trailing stop functionality.
